name: Yenna
source:
A mistreated waif from the town of Malling. Yenna's mother, [url=https://vndb.org/c165572]Gemma[/url], had an affair with a mysterious man. Yenna has suffered years of abuse at the hands of various men. Since meeting the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url], she has suddenly developed a mysterious ability to worm her way in to the hearts of others. Yenna has a fascination with elves and her [url=https://vndb.org/c165588]dream lady friend[/url].
